name: Empowerment
overview: Scripture reveals that true empowerment comes from the presence and power of God with His people. The LORD promises strength, courage, and His unfailing presence to those who trust Him, assuring they need not fear or be dismayed (Deuteronomy 31:6; Joshua 1:9; Isaiah 41:10). Jesus declares that all authority in heaven and earth belongs to Him (Matthew 28:18), and He grants believers power over the enemy through the Holy Spirit, enabling them to boldly witness and overcome spiritual opposition (Luke 10:19; Acts 1:8). This empowerment is both a divine gift and a call to faithful obedience under Christ's sovereign authority.
